title: 第21章 吞噬雷霆冲击天武境第22章 求救楚家危
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
楚云来到山顶后，便盘坐下来，开始运转《吞天诀》。
《吞天诀》可以吞噬很多能量，其中也包括雷霆之力。
不过因为实力原因，楚云不能一次性吞噬太多，不然容易被击伤。
随着时间流逝。
只见雷池里面的紫色雷霆，如丝线一般朝着楚云飘来，最后进入楚云的手掌心。
这种情况连续数天时间。
当第五天来临时，楚云缓缓睁开眼睛。
只见在他两只手掌心里面，出现两团如同鸡蛋大小的紫色雷霆。
“前辈，这算凝聚成功了吗？”
看着手掌心漂浮的紫色雷霆，楚云开口问道。
镜灵道：“不错，想不到才五天时间，你就凝聚成功了，看来跟你看过天雷掌的修炼方法有关系。”
楚云道：“我将雷霆之力吸入身体后，就用修炼天雷掌的方法，将雷霆之力运转到身体各个地方。”
“后面连续上百次后，我发现已经能够轻松凝聚出雷霆之力了。”
镜灵道：“看来是这掌法帮助了你，你现在试试看，能不能将天雷掌施展出来。”
“要是能够施展出来，就可以冲击天武境了。”
“好。”
听到这话，楚云站起身，然后开始施展天雷掌。
只见他双臂挥动，紫色雷霆便开始在他身上浮现。
“雷霆护体。”
随着手臂挥动，当楚云施展出天雷掌第一招雷霆护体后。

只见他的身上出现一道雷霆罡气，将他包裹在其中。
“雷霆巨兽！”
当楚云施展出第二招后，只见他每轰出一拳，强大的能量冲击波，就会化作一条雷霆巨兽，嘶吼着冲向不远处。
轰轰轰！
只见远处的巨石被击中，瞬间四分五裂。
雷霆四海！
神雷天罚！
轰隆！
当楚云施展出神雷天罚后，只见苍穹之上裂开一条口子，一道紫色雷霆猛然劈下。
轰！
咔嚓！
只见百丈远的一棵参天巨树，瞬间从中间一分为二。
这一幕，彻底震惊楚云。
这一招要是击在人身上，恐怕瞬间就会四分五裂。
而且这一招的威力，楚云感觉就算是地武境九重巅峰，恐怕也接不住。
“第四招的威力就如此恐怖，那第五招五雷轰顶，岂不是更厉害？”
content_en:
After Chu Yun reached the top of the mountain, he sat down cross-legged and started to run the "Swallowing Heaven Technique".
"Swallowing Heaven" can swallow a lot of energy, including the power of thunder.
However, due to his strength, Chu Yun could not swallow too much at once, otherwise he would be easily injured.
As time passes.
I saw the purple thunder in the thunder pool floating towards Chu Yun like a thread, and finally entered the palm of Chu Yun's hand.
This went on for several days.
When the fifth day came, Chu Yun slowly opened his eyes.
I saw two purple thunder balls as big as eggs appearing in the palms of his two hands.
"Senior, is this condensation successful?"
Looking at the purple thunder floating in the palm of his hand, Chu Yun asked.
Jing Ling said: "Yes, I didn't expect that you succeeded in condensing it in just five days. It seems to have something to do with the cultivation method of Sky Thunder Palm that you have seen."
Chu Yun said: "After I inhaled the power of thunder into my body, I used the method of practicing Heavenly Thunder Palm to circulate the power of thunder to every place in my body."
"After hundreds of times in a row, I found that I could easily gather the power of thunder."
Jing Ling said: "It seems that this palm technique has helped you. Try it now and see if you can use the Heavenly Thunder Palm."
"If it can be used, it can reach the Tianwu realm."
"Okay."
Upon hearing this, Chu Yun stood up and began to use the Thunder Palm.
As he waved his arms, purple thunder began to appear on his body.
"Thunder body protection."
As he waved his arms, Chu Yun used the first move of Thunder Palm to protect his body with thunder.
I saw a thunderous aura appearing on his body, wrapping him in it.
"Thunder Beast!"
When Chu Yun performed his second move, every time he punched out, a powerful energy shock wave would turn into a giant thunder beast, roaring and rushing not far away.
Boom boom boom!
I saw that the boulder in the distance was hit and fell apart instantly.
Thunder everywhere!
Divine Thunder and Heavenly Punishment!
Boom!
When Chu Yun used Divine Thunder and Heavenly Punishment, he saw a hole in the sky, and a purple thunder suddenly struck down.
boom!
Click!
I saw a towering tree a hundred feet away, split in two in an instant.
This scene completely shocked Chu Yun.
If this move hits a person, it will probably fall apart in an instant.
Moreover, with the power of this move, Chu Yun felt that even at the ninth level of Earth Martial Realm, he might not be able to catch it.
"The power of the fourth move is so terrifying, wouldn't the fifth move of Five Thunder Strike be even more powerful?"
